claims.scope: Every genuine Boolean f, every physical block A, every real r
Every finite-dimensional nonconstant genuine Boolean f
claims.statement: Some physical restriction g has R(g)>=R(f) and every nonconstant physical restriction h of g has R(h)<=R(g).

claims.scope: Every restriction-critical genuine Boolean g and every physical block A
Universal conditional implication over restriction-critical Boolean sources
claims.statement: If every restriction-critical g with at least two relevant coordinates has an influential proper block A with Gamma_A(g)<=K I_A(g), then H(f)<=K I(f) for every Boolean f.
There is a universal K such that some influential proper physical block A satisfies Gamma_A/I_A<=K.
claims.first_gap: Known criticality gives the reverse inequality Gamma_A>=R I_A; no universal upper selection theorem is proved.
